description: Reads a site's LightSpot editorial calendar over a period: imported slots, content being prepared, scheduled or published, and upcoming autopilot runs.

from.description: Inclusive start of the period, ISO 8601 with time zone.

to.description: Exclusive end of the period, ISO 8601 with time zone (366 days maximum).

name: get_editorial_calendar
title: Read a site's editorial calendar
